xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DescriptionOfSingleSegment: Generation of power through renewable sources and related services
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1 The consolidated financial results have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of Orient Green Power Co. Limited (the Holding Co.) at their respective meetings held on April 20, 2023. The financial results have been audited by the statutory auditors of the co.. 2 The Group operates in a single segment which is “Generation of power through renewable sources”. The CEO reviews the operations as a single segment. The operations of the group are seasonal in nature and the performance of any quarter may not be representative of the annual performance. 3.Considering the regulatory developments in Andhra Pradesh during the year FY 19-20, the group through M/s. Beta Wind Farm Pvt ltd could not proceed with Phase III power project. The capital advances issued could not be recovered from the vendor owing to their financial position. These advances are supported by a comfort letter issued by M/s. SVL Limited. The net advances receivable by the group is Rs.4000 lcs. Rs.1150 lcs were recovered during the year and the remaining Rs.2850 lcs are expected to be recovered within 1 year. Considering the expected credit losses recognized, this arrangement does not result in any impairment to the group.4 Considering the stay granted by the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India on the order issued by CERC on reduction of floor price and based on the legal opinion obtained, the Group is confident of favourable decision on the appeal with Supreme Court against the APTEL order and realization of difference of Rs.500 REC aggregating to Rs.2071 lcs in respect of the receivables as on 31 Mar 2017. the Group made provision of Rs. 497 lcs for expected credit losses till Mar 31 2023. 5. The group tested the Plant and Equipment of its material subsidiaries, Beta Wind Farm Pvt ltd and Clarion Wind Farm Pvt ltd for impairment. Such testing conducted by an independent technical expert and approved by the management did not result in any impairment losses. 6. During the year, the co. proposed to issue equity shares on a rights basis to the existing eligible equity shareholders for an amount aggregating up to Rs. 23,000 lcs. The proceeds of the said issue are proposed to be utilized towards inter alia, repayment of borrowings availed by the co. and its subsidiaries and general corporate purposes. The draft letter of offer dated Sep. 07, 2022 duly approved by the Rights issues committee was filed by the co. with SEBI and the stock exchanges on which the Rights Equity Shares are proposed to be listed. The co. received letters dated Sep. 19 and 21, 2022 from BSE and NSE respectively granting in-principle approval for undertaking the Issue. Further, SEBI issued final observations on the DLOF vide its letter dated February 13, 2023. The co. is in the process of filing the letter of offer with Stock Exchanges and SEBI. 7. The Financial results includes total income of Rs. 23 lcs, total loss after tax of Rs. 208 lcs and total comprehensive loss of Rs. 208 lcs for the year ended Mar. 31, 2023, after elimination, in respect of two subsidiaries viz. Amrit Environmental Technologies Pvt. Ltd and Orient Green Power Maharashtra Pvt Ltd whose financial statements were prepared by the Management on the basis other than that of going concern. The co. holds 74% and 100% of equity shares in AETPL and OGPML respectively. OGPML is under the process of voluntary strike off. 8. During the previous quarter, one of our promoters, M/s. Janati Bio Power Pvt Ltd informed the Stock Exchanges under Regulation 31 of the SEBI (SAST) Reg, 2011 that 15000000 Equity Shares of the Co. has been invoked by M/s. Axis Trustee Services limited out of 40000000 Shares pledged for a loan taken by one of the associates of JBPL not being the co. or its subsidiaries. Subsequent to this invocation, the holding of M/s. Janati Bio Power Pvt ltd holding in the co. is 32.48%. Note: CFS Notes has been restricted to 4000 characters. For balance notes refer pdf.
